entities.name: Marina Kroschina

entities.summary: Marina Vasilyevna Kroschina was a Ukrainian tennis player who competed for the Soviet Union. She won the 1971 Wimbledon girls' singles championships while competing for the Kazakh SSR, her country of birth.
